feeds.title: Amazon Fire TV Blog
feeds.description: Get the latest news, updates, information, and reviews about Amazon Fire TV. Amazon Fire TV is a line of digital media players and micro consoles developed by Amazon. The device is available in two form factors, a set-top box, and a HDMI plug-in stick. Fire TV Stick simplifies streaming with power, volume, and mute buttons in a single remote.

feeds.title: Amazon Luna Blog
feeds.description: Find the latest updates, information announcements, and more from team luna. Amazon Luna is a cloud gaming platform developed and operated by Amazon. Amazon Luna makes it easy to play your favorite games across devices without waiting for lengthy downloads and updates.
